theme: Auditing a fraction and claiming the whole
title: Royalty Audit: Defensible Recovery Under a Sampling Budget
strategies: trivial: fully census the single stratum that is cheapest to audit completely, touch nothing else (~0.1, the checker's own weak baseline)

greedy: sort every transaction by reported value descending and audit the biggest tickets until the budget runs out -- maximizes dollars sitting in the sample but is a judgmental top-of-range pick that usually fails representativeness/precision, so most of it is only worth a heavily discounted consolation credit

strong: census the cheapest-to-fully-audit stratum for certain money, then use the input's prior error-rate coefficient of variation to size a systematic, value-spread sample in the remaining strata (relative-margin-of-error formula) so its mean value-percentile lands near the stratum center -- unlocking a full defensible extrapolation there instead of a discounted consolation credit
invalid: emits a duplicate transaction id -> infeasible (0)
